key_highlights: ASX 200 tumbles as miners and banks sell off amid oil spike near $US100 and rising bond yields
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
RBA flags rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate-cut path
AUD shocker looms as commodity-driven weakness and oil-driven import costs diverge
Australia softens gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears; positive for energy names
WA gold exploration surge: Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania report high-grade hits
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising financial sector risk
Queensland on brink of credit rating downgrade; NSW faces stamp duty revenue hit
High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment remains resilient
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid; Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars

sectors.trend: Broadly negative. Iron ore weakness spreads (headline 77) pressuring majors. However, WA gold exploration is highly active with multiple high-grade discoveries. Copper strength supports Flagship. Austal $1.9b bid is a positive M&A signal.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face near-term headwinds from iron ore softness and Chinese inflation concerns. Gold juniors (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania) offer speculative upside. Copper exposure via Flagship is a relative outperformer.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and Bathla private credit collapse create credit-risk overhang. RBA rental inflation concern delays rate cuts, compressing NIM expectations. Queensland downgrade risk adds sovereign-credit noise.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from yield curve steepening and credit concerns. Private credit exposure (Bathla) is a tail risk. Queensland downgrade could hit local lenders' state-guaranteed lending.

sectors.trend: Mixed-positive. Oil near $US100 supports upstream names but triggers TACO (trade-asset-correction) dynamics. Australia's gas reservation softening is a structural positive for gas producers. AI data centres at coal plants create demand but clash with transition narrative.
sectors.implications: Woods Point, Origin, and gas-exposed names benefit from policy shift. Coal-to-data-centre pivot (headline 65) is a medium-term structural theme. Oil spike raises input costs for downstream.

sectors.trend: Under pressure. Woolworths breaches its own 'Price Freeze' on family staples, eroding consumer confidence. Record gas prices and rental inflation squeeze household budgets. Only Fans cited as masking unemployment data.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs and consumer caution. Defensive positioning in staples remains relevant but pricing power is questioned.

sectors.trend: Negative. High-end property sees steepest falls; Leith Van Onselen warns of biggest housing price fall. NSW stamp duty revenue hit signals policy tightening. RentTech compliance issues add regulatory risk.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) and construction names face demand softening at the top end. Affordable-segment resilience offers some support. Monitor RBA response to rental inflation.

sectors.trend: Globally, AI server stocks correct after two-day run. Domestically, AI data centres at coal plants signal infrastructure demand. Nasdaq crypto tokenisation partnership is a global theme.
sectors.implications: ASX tech exposure is limited but data-centre power demand benefits energy and infrastructure names. Global AI correction may reduce risk appetite for ASX tech-adjacent plays.

key_themes: Oil near $US100 driving global risk-off and TACO dynamics
Iron ore demand weakness linked to Chinese inflation surge
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth slowdown
AUD weakness risk from commodity divergence and oil import costs
WA gold exploration super-cycle in junior miners
Private credit contagion risk post-Bathla collapse
Energy transition vs AI data-centre power demand tension
Housing market bifurcation: luxury falls, affordable resilient

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil spike to $US100 triggering global risk-off and inflation re-acceleration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour downstream and consumer staples with pricing power; monitor RBA response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand deterioration from Chinese inflation and property slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper juniors

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD sharp depreciation ('shocker') from commodity weakness and oil import bill
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners and tourism names; monitor RBA intervention signals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private credit contagion from Bathla collapse spreading to ASX-listed lenders
risk_assessment.mitigation: Review bank credit-quality disclosures; avoid high-yield credit funds; monitor CBA.AX/WBC.AX NPL trends

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Queensland credit rating downgrade and NSW fiscal stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to Qld-domiciled REITs and infrastructure; monitor state bond spreads

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy dilemma: rental inflation vs growth, delaying rate cuts
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour fixed-income ladders; avoid rate-sensitive REITs and construction; monitor CPI and rental data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold juniors on exploration momentum
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Gateway $45M drill-out, Auric 102koz, Golden Dragon, Forrestania) signal a WA gold super-cycle; gold hedges oil-driven inflation

opportunities.recommendation: Add gas-exposed energy names on policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Australia softening gas reservation rules eases Asian supply fears; structural demand from AI data centres supports gas pricing

opportunities.recommendation: Position in copper via Flagship on red metal strength
opportunities.rationale: Copper soars on supply constraints and energy-transition demand; Flagship ups Canadian stakes

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and high-end property
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation focus delays cuts; luxury segment seeing steepest falls; NSW stamp duty hit signals policy tightening

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and reduce bank weightings on credit risk
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker risk from oil import bill; Bathla collapse raises private credit contagion fears

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash or short-duration bonds as buffer
defensive_moves.rationale: Bond yields rising; TACO dynamics create volatility; RBA policy uncertainty elevated

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil near $US100, iron ore softness, and rising bond yields create a risk-off backdrop. RBA's rental inflation focus delays rate cuts, weighing on property and banks. WA gold juniors and gas names are relative outperformers. AUD weakness adds import-cost inflation risk. Expect elevated volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if oil normalises and iron ore stabilises. Structural themes: WA gold exploration cycle, gas policy reform, AI data-centre power demand, and copper supply tightness support selective mining and energy upside. Housing bifurcation continues. RBA likely to cut 25–50bp by mid-2027 if inflation cools. Key risk is Chinese demand deterioration.
